objective: Capture major physical-carry effects with a small representative spot basket; do not maximize delivery precision.

j.method: Single representative adjusted spot; Tianjin is an early-history/overlap comparator, not an unadjusted splice.
assumptions: quoted standard assay represents the cash benchmark
missing Mf is not silently zero
j.data_gap: Rizhao starts 2018-01-02; early Tianjin conversion needs an explicit representative-assay assumption.

jm.method: Compare domestic and Mongolian washed-coal normalized proxies; optional minimum with winner recorded. Use domestic only when Mongolia is unavailable.
assumptions: Xiaoyi header assay treated as representative, not daily measurement
Mongolia assay and transport are declared scenarios
no automatic substitution with the newer Ganqimaodu ticker
jm.data_gap: Mongolian washed-coal series has a 495-calendar-day observation gap in 2016-2017.

ss.method: Single mill-edge cash benchmark plus 170 yuan/t for futures-equivalent edge normalization.
assumptions: representative 2.0mm 304/2B coil unless provider confirms another thickness
ss.data_gap: No SS futures carry before listing.

SM.method: Single Tianjin benchmark plus 0 before SM1911, 150 through SM2410, 190 from SM2411.
assumptions: Tianjin quote represents a comparable pickup basis
SM.data_gap: No major early-history gap found; do not apply the legacy +190 twice.

SF.method: Continuous national 72 benchmark; separate Ningxia-plus-basis sensitivity comparison from July 2019.
assumptions: national quote is representative rather than deliverable at one location
do not assign the Zhongwei premium to a national average
any constant freight approximation is labelled a model assumption
SF.data_gap: Ningxia quote begins 2019-07-15; national series covers 2016.
